meta.name: Rubik Sota Portfolio Museum DNA v1
meta.description: Original premium editorial-to-museum design system derived from the three museum sources plus Pear as pacing reference; not a copy of Pear.

neutral.usage: large quiet surfaces, strong dark type, subtle spatial depth

color.contrast_strategy: high-contrast editorial typography on warm neutral fields; dark museum ceiling separated by luminance not saturation

typography.font_style_notes: editorial grotesk feeling, tight large-scale tracking, calm utility copy; exact Pear font is not copied

spacing.section_rhythm: variable editorial rhythm; long breathing zones around primary statements, tighter transitions around narrative cues

layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric editorial alignment with strong shared edges

shape.border_usage: rare; thin museum/plaque and utility separators only

elevation.depth_cues: spatial overlap, light falloff, scale, selective blur, museum perspective

motion.philosophy: cinematic continuity; one progress authority; never bouncy or decorative for its own sake

components.button_style: text-led minimal CTA with subtle rule/arrow
components.card_style: avoid card-first composition; project surfaces are artworks/panels
components.modal_style: premium museum information panel with camera/input pause
components.list_style: clean typographic lists with restrained separators
components.component_notes: UI remains secondary to film and museum; no generic AI dashboard visual language

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an editorial film acting as the foyer to a contemporary digital museum
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary editorial web + modern gallery architecture

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: one dominant focal element per beat
visual_language.texture_usage: subtle film grain and natural material texture only when justified

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + spatial isolation + controlled overlap
composition.flow_direction: vertical editorial flow transitioning into spatial 3D exploration

imagery.photo_treatment: cinematic full-bleed video with preserved blacks/highlights; no generic overlays
imagery.illustration_style: original abstract/procedural artworks for placeholders only
imagery.graphic_elements: large typography, fine rules, restrained labels
imagery.image_shape: full-bleed cinematic field in intro; framed rectangular artworks in museum

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS/2D editorial sequence and static media on constrained/mobile devices
overview.primary_technology: scroll-linked DOM/video + React Three Fiber for museum

background_effects.description: master cinematic video scrubbed by scroll with a subtle proxy gradient when the production asset is absent

3d_elements.description: single elegant museum hall with framed Rubik Sota projects

shader_effects.description: No shader dependency in V1; introduce only if evidence shows clear value

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: reversible and tied to a single normalized progress

scroll_morphing.description: editorial film state transitions into museum threshold without snap navigation

text_effects.description: scene-specific copy reveals through clipping, line offsets and controlled opacity

cursor_effects.description: native cursor in V1 for reliability

image_effects.description: media and artwork entrances use restrained clipping/scale only

svg_animations.description: reserved for identity marks only if later required

visual_effects.composite_notes: The critical composite effect is not decorative: scroll progress, video time and copy cue state are one coordinated timeline. The museum remains a separate interaction mode entered after the editorial threshold. The absent production video must not be silently replaced.
